definition: the shape and style your hair is cut in
description: In a barbershop, a barber holds up a small spiral-bound notepad with a curved shape drawn on it and points at it with a pencil. He then works on a young man's hair with red electric clippers, shaving a sharp line into the side and fading the sides down. At the end the client turns his head and we see the finished cut: curly hair on top, shaved sides and a clean shaved line curving above the ear.

en.question: What is the young man getting?

es.answer: Se está haciendo un corte de pelo nuevo.

hacerse un corte de pelo nuevo
